name: agent-mail-inbox
description: Emit a notification for each new Agent Mail message addressed to $AGENT_NAME in the current project (or across $MAIL_WATCH_SCOPE / $AGENT_MAIL_PRODUCT, when set). Genuinely non-consuming: it tails the durable git-mailbox on disk (or the product bus in product mode) — plain OS file/DB reads that never mark mail read. `am check-inbox`, the one consuming path, has been retired from this notification path entirely (tcp-p0x.16.4). Still treat the notification as the delivery: it is the first surfacing of that mail, not a re-fetchable unread flag.
